extracted.name: Rosé sangria
extracted.description: This refreshing fruity drink is perfect for warmer weather, with nectarines, strawberries and orange liqueur - easily doubled for parties
ingredient_lines: 3 nectarines or peaches, stoned and sliced
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients, except the sparkling water and mint, in a large jug and stir to combine. Leave in the fridge for about 1 hr or until chilled, then top up with sparkling water and garnish with mint leaves to serve.
